name: reasoning-details-replay-suppresses-raw-reasoning
note: Upstream b7bb00b93. reasoning_details is the structured ALTERNATIVE to a raw reasoning field: turn 1 carries visible thinking AND a stored sequence, so reasoning_details is emitted and no reasoning/reasoning_content/reasoning_text key is written at all. Turn 2 has the same visible thinking with an ordinary 'reasoning_text' field-name signature and no sequence, so the raw field IS written there — the two turns must differ in exactly that way on both sides. Post-0.84.2 surface, so backend is src: REQUIRES PI_UPSTREAM_SHA >= b7bb00b93 (at an older pin pi still replays the pre-b7bb00b93 shape and this FAILs). Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.3 (release 4e58f324f); flipped to backend:"dist" — the published build is the stronger ground truth (README rule).
